# rezoooo.me

rezoooo.me reads a resume against a job description and returns a 0–100 match score, three weighted sub-scores, keyword gaps and plain-language feedback. The interface is calm and neutral so the results feel trustworthy. One warm orange carries the personality, along with the stretched "oooo" in the name.

> **Status:** wordmark Concept A + gauge favicon **approved** (2026-11-22). `danger-600` exception **approved**. Pages in progress, starting with the landing page.

---

## 1 · Wordmark & favicon (approved: Concept A + gauge icon)

**Idea.** The four o's are a row, and the fourth one is orange, like the box that finally gets ticked. The letters are Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold converted to outlines, so every o is a real letter and the name always reads as four o's. A filled orange dot was tried and dropped because at 16px it looked like a full stop, so the name read as "rezooo.me".

**Recommended set (Concept A)**

| Compact | ![rezoooo.me compact wordmark](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) | Sidebar header, mobile top bar. All letters `ink`, tracking +10/1000 so the o's stay apart at small sizes. | 16px |

**Rules**
- The name is always `rezoooo.me`: lowercase, four o's, with `.me`. Never "Rezoome", "Rezoooo" or "REZOOOO.ME", including in headings, alt text, emails and the page `<title>`.
- In running text, write the name as plain text. Use the wordmark artwork only in logo positions.
- **Logo vs motif.** The logo is only (a) the wordmark SVG, which is outlined letters, never typed text, or (b) the gauge-o icon. The header and footer both use the wordmark file: full at 24px or more, compact at 16px on mobile. The **four-ring row** (three ink rings, the last one `orange-500`, no letters) is a *decorative motif*, not a logo. It may appear in illustrations and call-to-action cards, at most once per page, never in the header or footer, never next to the wordmark, and never in place of it.
- The 4th o is always `orange-500`. The rest of the mark is `ink`. Don't recolour it, outline it, add a gradient or animate the sidebar mark.
- Keep clear space of at least one o-width on every side.
- Light surfaces only (`surface` or `canvas`). The app has no dark mode, so there is no reversed version yet.
- Browser tab title format: **`Page name | rezoooo.me`**. Examples: `Dashboard | rezoooo.me`, `New analysis | rezoooo.me`, `Result · Backend Engineer | rezoooo.me`, `Sign in | rezoooo.me`. The landing page is `Resume match checker | rezoooo.me`. No exceptions. Design files and canvases use the same format (`Landing page | rezoooo.me`).

---

## 2 · Voice

- Friendly and slightly playful around the edges: greetings, empty states, loading captions ("Reading every bullet point…").
- Results are plain and professional: no jokes next to a score, no exclamation marks in feedback, and every claim tied to the job description.
- Use second person, short sentences and verbs on buttons ("Analyze resume", "Re-analyze", "View in History").
- Errors say what happened and what to do next: "That file is 6.2 MB. The limit is 4 MB. Try exporting a smaller PDF."

## 3 · Colour

- **Neutral-first.** `canvas` behind everything. Content sits on `surface` cards. Text uses `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle`.
- **Orange is the brand and the main action.** Graphics use `orange-500`: the wordmark o, the gauge arc, the usage pill and the focus ring. White text can't sit on `orange-500` (3.05:1), so primary buttons and links use `orange-600` (4.7:1). `orange-50` with `orange-700` text is the tinted pair.
- **Two cool accents, one job each,** used here and there to balance the warmth:
  - **Blue = in progress and information:** Processing status, the active step, info banners (scanned PDF, busy queue) and semantic match.
  - **Olive = done and matched:** Done status, matched keywords, strengths, connected sign-in methods and keyword coverage.
  - Use `-500` for graphics only, `-600` for text on surface, and `-50` with `-700` for tinted pills and banners.
  - Never use blue or olive for primary buttons or decoration with no meaning.
- **Sub-score colour code:** semantic match is `blue-500`, keyword coverage is `olive-500`, AI-judged fit is `ink`. The same three colours appear wherever the score breakdown is shown.
- **Priority tags use orange intensity:** Critical = `orange-600` fill + `on-accent`. High = `orange-50` fill + `orange-700` text. Medium = `surface-sunken` + `ink-muted`.
- **Status pills:**
  - Queued = dashed gray outline.
  - Processing = `blue-50` + `blue-700` with a blue dot.
  - Done = `olive-50` + `olive-700` with a check.
  - Failed = `danger-50` + `danger-600`.
- **Red is for errors only:** validation errors, Failed and destructive actions (`danger-600`, approved).

## 3a · Scoring display

- Final score = **0.40 × semantic match + 0.30 × keyword coverage + 0.30 × AI-judged fit**, rounded half up to a whole number.
- Always show each sub-score with its weight (`82 ×0.40`) so the final number can be traced.
- Reference example used in every mockup: 82, 71 and 80 give 32.8 + 21.3 + 24.0 = 78.1, shown as **78**.
- **Text never truncates in result content.** Feedback lines, keyword chips, job roles and file names wrap to more lines. Only marketing previews may shorten copy, and they rewrite it shorter rather than cutting it off with an ellipsis.

## 4 · Type

Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts, OFL), weights 400/500/600/700/800. Use tabular numbers for scores, counters and dates. Scale: `display-xl` 64 → `display-lg` 40 → `h1` 30 → `h2` 22 → `h3` 17 → `body` 15 → `small` 13 → `caption` 12. On mobile, the hero drops one display step and page titles stay `h1`.

## 5 · Space, radius, elevation

- 4px grid (`space-1` … `space-24`). Card padding is `space-6`, or `space-10` for hero cards. Page gutter is `space-8` on desktop and `space-4` on mobile.
- Radius: inputs `radius-sm` 8, buttons/dropzone `radius-md` 12, cards `radius-lg` 16, modals/landing cards `radius-xl` 24, pills `radius-full`.
- Elevation: superseded by section 5a (clay and glass). `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md` and `shadow-lg` are kept for flat surfaces only. No glows.

## 5a · Depth: clay and glass

**Clay is for things you press or pick up. Glass is only for layers that float. Everything else stays flat.**

- **Primary buttons:** `clay-primary-gradient` (orange-600 at the top, `clay-primary-bottom` at the bottom), `shadow-clay-primary`, radius 12. Hover lifts 1px with `shadow-clay-primary-hover`. Pressed moves down 1px with `shadow-clay-primary-pressed`. White text stays at least 4.7:1 across the whole gradient.
- **Raised controls** (secondary and icon buttons, unselected tabs, pills, the dropzone): `clay-raised-gradient`, `clay-raised-border`, `shadow-clay-raised`.
- **Pressed-in states:** the selected tab (`clay-pressed`) and the active nav item (`clay-pressed-nav`) use `shadow-clay-pressed`. Selected never looks raised.
- **Cards:** `clay-card-gradient`, `clay-card-border`, `shadow-clay-card`, `radius-card` 20 or `radius-card-xl` 28.
- **Inputs stay sunken:** `sunken-bg`, `shadow-sunken`, with the `border-control` border kept for 3:1. Placeholders and counters on `sunken-bg` use `ink-muted`.
- **Glass**, only for the usage pill, user menu, toasts, modals, the mobile drawer and the landing page's floating cards:
  - `glass-blur`, `glass-border` and `shadow-glass` on every glass layer.
  - A `glass-blob-gradient` shape sits behind each one so the glass has something to refract. Some layers pair it with a cool `glass-blob-cool-gradient` shape.
  - There are three densities, chosen by the worst-case backdrop so muted text keeps at least 4.5:1:
    - `glass-fill` (72%) only over the canvas or the warm blob.
    - `glass-fill-dense` (88%) where it can float over the orange button.
    - `glass-fill-solid` (94%) over the 40% scrim.
- **Never glass:** body text blocks, feedback, tables, or any card with long copy.
- **Moulded:** the score gauge sits on a clay puck, with a soft drop shadow on the arc. The four-ring motif gets a gradient stroke and a soft shadow.
- **Fallbacks:**
  - `prefers-reduced-transparency`: glass becomes solid white with a `border` and no blur, and blobs are hidden.
  - `prefers-reduced-motion`: no lift or sink and no transition.
  - No `backdrop-filter` support: 96% white.
  - The focus ring (2px `orange-500`, 2px offset) is unchanged everywhere.
- Reference artboards: **Depth style** and **Depth fallback** on the App design canvas.

## 6 · Iconography

Line icons with a 1.5px stroke on a 20px grid and rounded caps, in `ink` or `ink-muted` (active nav uses `orange-600`). Proposed set: Lucide (ISC licence). No emoji in the UI.

## 7 · Build notes and flags

- The wordmark ships as SVG (outlined letters). Don't rebuild it with live text, because the orange o would need a split `<span>` and kerning would drift.
- The favicon has its own 16px-tuned file. Ship `favicon.svg` plus a 32px PNG fallback and a 180px apple-touch icon generated from `rezoooo-icon.svg`.
- `orange-500` fails text contrast. Any orange text must use `orange-600` or `orange-700`.
- `border-control` is darker than the soft card `border` so inputs meet 3:1. Inputs will look slightly crisper than the reference shot's cards, which is intended.
